name: TheMealDB
summary: Free recipe database: meals by name, ingredient, category or area, with instructions and images.
description: Crowd-sourced recipes with ingredients and measures (strIngredient1..20), instructions, YouTube links, thumbnails, categories and cuisines. Endpoints for search, lookup, random, filter and lists. The test key '1' is free for development and education; a paid Patreon key unlocks extra endpoints.

auth.notes: The key is part of the URL path (/api/json/v1/{key}/). Test key 1 is for dev and education; a personal key is a paid Patreon perk.

rate_limit.summary: Not numerically documented; the test key is intended for development and education.

endpoints.summary: Filter by ingredient, category or area

license.name: Free for educational and development use with the test key; commercial use needs a paid supporter key; no open data license

agent_notes: Ingredients and measures are flat columns (strIngredient1..20, strMeasure1..20) that need normalising. filter.php returns only summary fields, so follow up with lookup.php?i= for full recipes.
caveats: Terms restrict commercial use under the free key.

verification.notes: Executed with the public test key 1.
